title: Робоча картка сеансу
fields_and_relations: Контекст, location_environment, numbered participants, спільний position творів/ФЕІ, точний склад O14.
required_interaction: Зберегти агрегат; змінити порядок → нова revision; стара форма O15 лишається старою.

implementation.view_model: WF-03: separate lists and contextual forms for session context, participants/consents, events, real media import and short device capture, playback, versioned primary index and frozen session form; WF-04 handoff; feedback: stable session participant codes, explicit per-unit performers/collectors, list/full-text search and in-place edit, private oral consent upload/interval/live recording and proof links Separate informants, collectors, consents and other attendees; distinct per-record attribution; direct exact-revision media fragment links and consent annotations. Full-file annotation workspace: sticky player, decoded waveform, layer timelines, contents/layers modes, search, active text, interval selection, exact links and supported EAF 3.0 import/export. Separate programme/questionnaire list with text and original PDF, exact ordered revisions, session-specific pinned list and explicit refresh. Session form optionally appends selected questionnaire text; default lists titles only. Respondent terminology throughout UI.
limitations: Browser-local storage up to 2 MiB per file and 30 seconds per live recording; no shared backend, long continuous device recording, independent backups or network transfer. Full transcription/subtitle alignment remains WF-24.

EAF subset: concrete time slots, independent alignable tiers, Symbolic Association/Subdivision. Other constraints, vocabularies, external links and nonzero media time origins are rejected. No automatic alignment or multi-file synchronized player.
PDF up to 2 MiB in local browser storage; PDF originals available separately, not embedded into TXT session forms. Session refresh copies the whole current research questionnaire set.
implementation.state_storage: Shared normalized browser store; fixture version 9
permissions: field.write / capture.field / consent.read / consent.write / intake.send in archive scope
implementation.atomicity: Authorize, expected revision, clone, validate, hash, commit. No partial mutation on failure.
